title: Publish FFTA DE-ReBuild 1.1.0

validation: GitHub reports v1.1.0 as public and latest, with tag pointing to 6bcf5d27f1ce8a1395b40436f3760c7ee3f61166; all nine uploaded asset sizes and SHA256 digests matched the staged files.
